convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iFractals indicator with straightforward entry/exit rules. No external .mqh libraries, no custom indicators, no grid/martingale logic. Simple fractal breakout with fixed SL/TP and basic position management.

derived_values.name: Minimum distance for fractal signal validity in points
derived_values.used_by: entry_rules (fractal must be Min_Dist points away from current price)

other_exits: Fractal minimum distance breakout can implicitly reverse direction if opposite fractal triggers while flat

custom_logic_notes: The EA scans back through historical bars (up to 100 bars) to find the most recent valid fractal. A buy signal fires when Ask exceeds the upper fractal level plus Min_Dist points. A sell signal fires when Bid drops below the lower fractal level minus Min_Dist points. The fractal search iterates from bar index 2 onward (fractals need 2 bars on each side to form), finding the first bar where the fractal buffer is non-zero. Digit adjustment logic checks if _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001, multiplying SL, TP, and Min_Dist by 10 to handle 5-digit broker pricing.
python_conversion_notes: Fractals require a 5-bar window (2 bars left + center + 2 bars right). Implement fractal detection as: high[2] > high[1] && high[2] > high[0] && high[2] > high[3] && high[2] > high[4] for upper fractal, analogous logic for lower fractal. Scan back N bars to find most recent fractal. Compare current close/price against fractal level ± Min_Dist. Digit adjustment: detect 5-digit pricing and scale pip values by 10. New bar guard needed to prevent multiple entries per bar. Position check ensures only one position at a time.
